title: 马斯克生态：机会不等于同涨
Musk ecosystem: one story, three risks
points: SPCX：周期窗口与企业兑现
TSLA：修复必须经得住价格检验
ASTEROID：叙事联动，不是公司权益
SPCX: cycle window and business execution
TSLA: price must confirm the recovery
ASTEROID: narrative exposure, not equity
zh: 这一期，我们把SpaceX、特斯拉和太空狗放在一起研究，但先给结论：它们可以共享马斯克话题，却不是同一种资产，也不一定同时上涨。
我的基准判断是，SPCX的九月周期机会值得重点跟踪；特斯拉先看修复能否成立；太空狗只能作为高风险的情绪观察对象，不能当成两家公司的第三只股票。
研究截点为北京时间二零二六年九月五日晚，美股价格使用九月四日已收盘数据。下面分别讲事实、卦象和可检验的后续情景。
en: This episode examines SpaceX, Tesla and Asteroid together. My starting point is simple: they may share a Musk narrative, but they are different assets and need not rise together.
My base case prioritizes the September cycle window in SPCX. Tesla must first establish a credible recovery. Asteroid is a high-risk sentiment watch, not a third equity stake in these companies.

The research cutoff is the evening of September fifth, twenty twenty-six, Beijing time. Equity prices use the completed September fourth session. We separate facts, symbolic readings and testable forward scenarios.

title: 合并传闻：有公开讨论，没有确认交易
Merger speculation is not a signed deal
points: 7月22日：公开讨论业务重叠
7月30日：相关中国业务出售报道遭否认
公告／协议／批准／交割：四个不同阶段
July 22: public discussion of business overlap
July 30: China-sale report rejected
Announcement / agreement / approvals / closing
zh: 合并话题不是突然出现的。路透社七月二十二日报道，马斯克在财报电话会上没有排除可能性，并谈到双方业务重叠增加。七月三十日，他又否认了为合并准备出售中国业务的相关报道。
这两条公开信息放在一起，说明话题有讨论基础，也说明传闻细节很容易走样。本轮检查没有找到两家公司已经签署合并协议、或者承诺九月宣布合并的正式公告。
因此，九月继续出现讨论，是值得观察的情景；九月必定官宣，不是我认可的事实。即使出现公告，还要分清只是研究可能性、签署协议，还是已经完成交割。
en: This discussion did not begin overnight. Reuters reported on July twenty-second that Musk did not rule out a combination and described increasing business overlap. On July thirtieth, he rejected a related report about preparing to sell Tesla's China operations.

Together, these reports show both a basis for discussion and the danger of unreliable details. This review did not find an official signed merger agreement or a company commitment to announce one in September.

Further discussion in September is a scenario worth watching. A guaranteed September announcement is not an established fact. Even an announcement must be distinguished from an exploratory review, a signed agreement, and a completed transaction.
slides.source: Reuters, July 22 and July 30, 2026 | Company IR checked Sep 5

title: 第一卦：火泽睽，问合并与利好
Chart one: Opposition, transaction and benefit
points: 静卦：没有动爻、没有变卦
世爻子孙酉金逢空；财子水伏藏
父母巳火持应：消息与价格不能混为一谈
Static chart: no moving lines or changed hexagram
You-metal self line is void; wealth is hidden
News and shareholder benefit are different tests
zh: 第一张是九月五日二十点十五分的火泽睽静卦，问的是近期合并并带来利好。按用神、财爻、世应和旺衰优先的方法，先把问题拆开：文件消息看父母，获利条件看财爻，不能见到合的字眼就断股价大涨。
图中世爻子孙酉金逢申酉空，妻财子水伏在兄弟未土之下，父母巳火持应。我的传统象意解读是，期待与落实之间还有距离，收益条件尚未明朗；睽也提示两边利益、安排可能存在分歧。
所以这张卦不支持把近期顺利合并、立即获利当成强结论。静卦不是永远不会发生，空亡也不能机械译成某天必兑现。这里没有足够依据给出官宣日期。
en: The first chart, cast at eight fifteen p.m. on September fifth, is the static hexagram Opposition. It asks about a near-term merger and a favorable result. My traditional reading starts with the relevant lines, wealth, self and counterpart, and their strength. An announcement and a profitable outcome are separate questions.

The You-metal self line is marked void, the Zi-water wealth line is hidden beneath Wei-earth, and a parent line occupies the counterpart. Symbolically, I read a gap between expectation and implementation, with the benefit still unclear. Opposition also suggests competing interests or arrangements.

This does not support a strong claim of an easy near-term merger followed by immediate gains. A static chart does not mean never, and void does not supply an automatic fulfillment date. There is insufficient basis for an announcement date.
slides.source: User chart: Sep 5, 20:15 Beijing | Symbolic interpretation, not event evidence

title: 第二卦：革之小过，问九月消息
Chart two: Revolution to Small Exceeding
points: 初爻、五爻动；不是四爻齐动
父母酉金化申金：消息线动而逢空
可观察话题发酵；不能升级为交易落实
Moving lines: one and five only
Parent You-metal changes to Shen-metal: both void
Watch discussion; do not assume completion
zh: 第二张是二十点二十三分的泽火革变雷山小过，问九月会不会放出合并消息。初爻和五爻发动，五爻父母酉金化父母申金，本日申酉空；初爻子孙卯木化官鬼辰土。
用神层看，消息线有动象，却不能忽略空亡；节奏层看，可能先有讨论，再面对条件和疑问；卦象层的革提示变化议题，小过提醒把声量与实际进展分开。我的解读偏向消息值得跟踪、落实保持保留，而不是九月必合并。
两张卦只隔八分钟，出自同一人、同一话题，并不是两份独立证据。它们不能用来翻倍信心。六爻属于传统象征性研究，目前没有足够可靠证据证明能稳定预测股价或公司交易。
en: The second chart, at eight twenty-three p.m., changes from Revolution to Small Exceeding. Its question is whether merger news will appear in September. Only lines one and five move. The parent line changes from You-metal to Shen-metal, both marked void. The first line changes from Mao-wood to Chen-earth.

The announcement line moves, but its void status cannot be ignored. A timing-oriented reading allows discussion followed by conditions and questions. The symbolic reading points to change while warning that publicity may exceed progress. My interpretation favors monitoring the story, not declaring a September merger certain.

These charts were cast eight minutes apart by the same person about the same topic. They are not independent evidence and cannot double confidence. Liu Yao is a traditional symbolic framework; reliable evidence that it consistently predicts prices or corporate transactions is insufficient.
slides.source: User chart: Sep 5, 20:23 Beijing | Correlated charts, not independent votes

title: SPCX：重点是周期，不押注合并原因
SPCX: the cycle thesis does not require a merger
points: 半年原课：9/7—10/7为高位候选窗口
网站9/7—20偏强；9/21起防冲高回吐
窗口内可能见高点，不等于一直涨到末日
Six-month source: Sep 7–Oct 7 candidate high window
Existing weekly thesis: firmer early, cautious later
A high within a window is not a rally until its end
zh: 周期层面，以七月二十七日的半年专项六爻为主要参考。原课关注酉月，也就是九月七日至十月七日的高位候选窗口，没有锁定具体价位。我们沿用这一时间假说，但不能替它加上合并一定是上涨原因。
网站已有的周度路径是，九月七日至二十日偏强推进，二十一日这一周开始防冲高回吐。这与一个月内可能形成阶段高点可以并存，不是要求拿到十月七日才防守。
辅助看个人月卦随变颐，财爻持世但上爻财化兄弟，仍有资金分流的提醒。这里是有分歧的支持，不是四个流派一致保证上涨。也没有补造同周期奇门盘来增加票数。
en: For the cycle layer, the July twenty-seventh six-month Liu Yao lesson is the main reference. It identifies September seventh through October seventh as a candidate high window without locking a price target. We retain that timing hypothesis, but do not invent a merger as its necessary cause.

The site's existing weekly path favors firmer movement from September seventh through the twentieth, followed by greater risk of a rally fading in the week beginning the twenty-first. A high somewhere inside a month-long window does not mean waiting until its last day to defend gains.

The supplementary personal month chart, Following to Nourishment, has wealth at the self line but also wealth changing to a competing line above. That leaves a warning about capital diversion. This is qualified support, not four schools guaranteeing gains, and no missing Qimen chart is fabricated.
slides.source: Private research source ledger | Existing SPCX weekly records, not revised

title: SPCX：真实业务与资金消耗要一起看
SPCX: operating opportunity versus capital intensity
points: 星链连接收入、发射与AI业务
技术兑现／监管／资本投入是检验点
9/10公司会议：观察经营信息，不预设合并
Connectivity, launch and AI businesses
Execution, regulation and funding matter
Sep 10 company conference: listen, do not presume
zh: 现实层面，SPCX现在对应SpaceX上市普通股。公司六月十一日的定价公告确认每股一百三十五美元的首次公开发行。投资逻辑不能只剩马斯克名字，还要看星链服务、发射能力和AI业务能否形成可持续回报。
多头在期待业务协同、规模和技术兑现；反方要问资本开支、竞争、监管与执行风险。这是我对公开业务资料的多空梳理，不是声称所有机构已经形成共识。
公司已公告，首席财务官将在九月十日美西时间中午十二点二十五分参加高盛科技会议，对应北京时间十一日凌晨三点二十五分。这是经营信息观察点，不能预先说成合并发布会。
en: SPCX now represents SpaceX common stock. Its June eleventh pricing announcement confirmed an initial public offering at one hundred thirty-five dollars a share. The thesis must extend beyond Musk's name to whether connectivity, launch capability and AI can generate durable returns.

The bullish case anticipates scale, collaboration and technological execution. The countercase asks about investment requirements, competition, regulation and delivery risk. This is my synthesis of public business information, not a claim that institutions share a single consensus.

The company has announced a Goldman Sachs technology conference appearance by its chief financial officer on September tenth at twelve twenty-five p.m. Pacific time, or three twenty-five a.m. on September eleventh in Beijing. It is an operating-information checkpoint, not a presumed merger presentation.
slides.source: SpaceX IPO release; Q2 10-Q; Aug 27 conference announcement

title: SPCX：上涨需要跨过哪道门
SPCX: where the bullish case must prove itself
points: 152—154：突破并回踩站稳才加分
141—138失守：偏强执行情景降级
Sep 4 close: 147.95 | Sep 3 high: 152.30
152–154: breakout plus a successful retest
Loss of 141–138 weakens the bullish setup
zh: 以本期引用的收盘数据看，SPCX九月四日收一百四十七点九五，九月三日最高一百五十二点三零。结合七月的成交区，一百五十二至一百五十四先当作压力观察区。
偏强情景需要放量越过压力，随后回踩不破，才逐步讨论一百五十九至一百六十八的历史价格区域；这不是卦象给出的目标，也不是必须到达。
如果突破失败，或者跌回一百四十一至一百三十八下方，短线执行条件就要降级。长期周期看好不能代替止损。各平台收盘报价可能存在细微差异，实际操作前应复核自己交易渠道的行情。
en: In the closing dataset used here, SPCX finished September fourth at one hundred forty-seven ninety-five, after a September third high of one hundred fifty-two thirty. Together with July trading, the one fifty-two to one fifty-four area is the first resistance zone to watch.

The stronger scenario needs a volume-backed breakout followed by a retest that holds. Only then does the historical one fifty-nine to one sixty-eight area become relevant. These are technical reference zones, not divination targets or guaranteed destinations.

A failed breakout, or a decline below the one forty-one to one thirty-eight area, weakens the short-term setup. A favorable cycle thesis does not replace loss control. Closing quotes can vary slightly across providers; verify the prices supplied by your own trading venue.
slides.source: Stock Analysis / Tiingo, daily OHLC through Sep 4 | Zones: MOOX analysis

title: 特斯拉：经营改善与估值争议并存
Tesla: business progress, valuation debate
points: 增长期待：Robotaxi、储能、AI与机器人
检验条件：利润、现金流与商业化
参股与采购合作，不等于已经合并
Bull case: autonomy, storage, AI and robotics
Tests: margins, cash flow and commercialization
Investment and purchases do not equal a merger
zh: 特斯拉的多头期待主要来自自动驾驶、Robotaxi、储能和机器人。第二季度申报文件披露，公司预计二零二六年资本开支超过二百五十亿美元。所以反方会追问，投入何时变成持续利润，商业化进度是否支撑估值。
双方确有经济联系。特斯拉披露持有SpaceX少于百分之一的权益；SpaceX披露上半年采购特斯拉Megapack。但参股、采购、同一位负责人，都不是已完成合并的证明。
即使未来真的出现交易安排，两边股东也未必同等受益。换股比例、融资摊薄、审批条件以及市场是否已提前计价，都会决定消息后的股价反应。
en: Tesla's bullish narrative centers on autonomy, Robotaxi, energy storage and robotics. Its second-quarter filing projects more than twenty-five billion dollars of capital expenditure in twenty twenty-six. The counterargument asks when investment becomes durable profit and whether commercialization supports the valuation.

There are real economic ties. Tesla discloses an equity interest below one percent in SpaceX, while SpaceX reports purchases of Tesla Megapacks in the first half. An investment, purchases and a shared leader do not establish a completed merger.

Even a future transaction would not guarantee equal benefits for both shareholder groups. Exchange terms, dilution, approval conditions and what the market has already priced in would shape the reaction.
slides.source: Tesla Q2 2026 10-Q | SpaceX Q2 2026 10-Q, related-party disclosures

title: 特斯拉：先看修复，不照搬SPCX路径
Tesla: a recovery test, not a copy of SPCX
points: 网站9/7—13：先涨后跌，防反弹退守
Existing Sep 7–13 thesis: rise, then fade risk
354.08 close | First recovery test: 365–369
376–384 resistance | 345–350 support watch
zh: 特斯拉没有在本轮找到丙午老师同窗口的专项原课，所以不能把SpaceX的半年结论搬过来。当前网站九月七日至十三日的既有周度路径是先涨后跌，重点防修复后的退守。个人九月卦讼变同人，可以研究分歧向协调变化，但本身不能证明合并。
现实价格也需要尊重。九月四日特斯拉收三百五十四点零八，前一天高点三百八十四点零四。先收复三百六十五至三百六十九，再看三百七十六至三百八十四压力，才有逐级改善的含义。
下方三百四十五至三百五十是近期承接观察区，失守且收不回来就不能强行解释成健康洗盘。我没有完整可核验的缠论中枢和背驰证据，因此本期只称价格结构，不冒称缠论三买已经成立。
en: This review did not locate a same-window specialist Tesla lesson from the primary teacher. The SpaceX six-month conclusion cannot be transferred to Tesla. The site's existing September seventh through thirteenth weekly path is rise-then-fade, emphasizing retreat risk after a recovery. The personal month chart, Conflict to Fellowship, symbolically allows improving coordination, but does not establish a merger.

Price evidence matters. Tesla closed September fourth at three hundred fifty-four oh-eight, versus a previous-day high of three hundred eighty-four oh-four. Reclaiming three sixty-five to three sixty-nine is the first step; three seventy-six to three eighty-four is the next resistance area.

The three forty-five to three fifty area is a recent support watch. A break that cannot be reclaimed is not automatically healthy consolidation. A complete, verifiable Chan structure is unavailable here, so these are price zones, not a claim that a confirmed Chan third-buy pattern exists.
slides.source: Existing TSLA weekly record | Stock Analysis / S&P Global, Sep 4 cutoff

title: 太空狗：联想能带来流量，不能带来股权
Asteroid: attention is not a claim on earnings
points: 社区声明：与SpaceX无隶属或背书关系
只有资金买入，叙事才可能转成价格
Ethereum contract: 0xf280…694126
Community disclaimer: no SpaceX affiliation
Attention needs real buyers and liquidity
zh: 太空狗先核对身份：本期讨论的是以太坊上合约零叉f二八零开头、六九四一二六结尾的ASTEROID。社区网站明确声明，它是独立社区代币，与SpaceX没有隶属或背书关系。
因此，即使两家公司发布利好，代币持有人也没有获得股票、分红、订单或合并对价的权利。可能的传导只是注意力上升、社群传播、买盘进入，任何一环断掉，股涨币不涨完全可能。
我不会把爆发收益列为基准情景。它有情绪放大的可能，也有流动性枯竭、集中抛售和大幅亏损的可能。合约身份核对不等于完成了安全审计。
en: First identify the asset. This episode concerns the Ethereum ASTEROID contract beginning zero-x-f-two-eight-zero and ending six-nine-four-one-two-six. Its community website states that it is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by SpaceX.

Even favorable company news gives token holders no equity, dividends, orders or merger consideration. The possible transmission is attention, community distribution and actual buying. If any link fails, the stocks can rise while the token does not.

Explosive returns are not my base case. Sentiment can amplify a move, but liquidity can disappear and concentrated selling can create severe losses. Verifying the contract identity is not the same as completing a security audit.
slides.source: asteroideth.com community disclaimer | Full contract in member source notes

title: 太空狗卦：不能只看“大有”两个字
Asteroid chart: the name alone is not bullish evidence
points: 9月卦：火天大有→雷风恒
财寅木逢空；子孙子水动化丑土
消息、量能、流动性、价格：四项分开检验
September chart: Great Possession to Duration
Wealth Yin-wood is void; funding line changes
Test news, volume, liquidity and price separately
zh: 回看个人九月卦，主卦火天大有变雷风恒，初爻子孙子水发动化父母丑土，财爻寅木又遇原盘寅卯空。按财爻与财源优先，不应因为卦名叫大有，就忽略兑现能力和阻滞。
传统解读可以保留修复与持续性的观察，但不能由此承诺翻倍，更不能将两张公司消息卦当成代币盈利证据。假设市值九百万美元，回到四千万需要约四点四四倍价格，涨幅约百分之三百四十四；这只是供应量不变时的算术，不是目标预测，也不代表实际需要流入三千一百万。
要上调判断，至少看到可核验催化、成交持续、足够池子流动性，以及突破后回踩守住。若只有消息转发，没有这些条件，继续列为高风险观察，不宣布底部已经出现。
en: The personal September chart changes from Great Possession to Duration. The first funding line changes from Zi-water to Chou-earth, while the Yin-wood wealth line is void in the original chart. A wealth-first reading should not ignore uncertain realization just because the hexagram has a favorable name.

A symbolic reading can leave room for recovery and persistence, but cannot promise a multiple of returns. The corporate-news charts are not proof of token profit. Hypothetically, a nine-million-dollar capitalization reaching forty million requires roughly four point four four times the price at unchanged supply. That is arithmetic, not a forecast, and does not imply thirty-one million dollars of actual inflows.

An upgrade requires a verifiable catalyst, persistent trading activity, adequate pool liquidity and a breakout that survives a retest. Reposted headlines alone do not meet those conditions. Without them, this remains a high-risk watch, not a confirmed bottom.
slides.source: User September ASTEROID chart | $9m → $40m is a hypothetical, not live data

title: 把预测变成可复盘的检查表
A forward checklist, not a hindsight story
points: 9/8复市：看承接和突破，不追标题
9/10会议：听真实经营与资本安排
9/21起提高防守；9/30核对消息情景
10/7窗口结束；半年高点须等全周期验证
Sep 8 reopening: test price acceptance
Sep 10 conference: assess actual disclosures
More defense after Sep 21; news review Sep 30
Oct 7 ends the window, not the six-month test
zh: 最后给一张可以执行研究、可以复盘的时间表。九月七日美国劳动节，美股休市，八日复市后看价格承接；不能安排七日买入股票，也不能因为休市就倒推四日一定该买。
九月十日公司会议看是否有实质经营信息。二十一日开始对SPCX的冲高回吐提高警惕；三十日检查九月消息情景，有正式消息、只有讨论、没有消息，要分开记录。十月七日检查周期窗口表现，但半年最高点必须等到明年一月二十七日的完整观察期结束才能评价。
总之，我更重视SPCX的周期加价格确认，特斯拉先看修复质量，太空狗只看条件触发。任何一项不兑现都保留记录，不改写旧预测。内容是带条件的研究，不是自动下单指令，也没有收益保证。
en: Here is the forward review schedule. U.S. equity markets are closed for Labor Day on September seventh. Watch price acceptance after reopening on the eighth. A calendar window does not create a holiday stock-trading opportunity, or retroactively prove that buying on the fourth was correct.

At the September tenth conference, look for substantive operating information. From the twenty-first, raise attention to SPCX rally-fade risk. On the thirtieth, distinguish official news, discussion only, and no news. Review the cycle window on October seventh, but the six-month-high hypothesis cannot be judged until the full period ends on January twenty-seventh next year.

In summary, SPCX needs its cycle thesis plus price confirmation. Tesla first needs a better recovery. Asteroid requires its own conditions. Preserve failures as well as successes. This is conditional research, not an automatic trading instruction or a guarantee of returns.
slides.source: NYSE 2026 calendar | Evaluation rules fixed before outcomes
